races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete will take them along at a steady pace with no early pressure, given his strong front-running record on similar going (6/7 similar races, all prominent). The danger emerges from 2f out when six prominent runners (Prince Of Clova, Double Tiger, Emerald Time, Chico Magnifica, Hashtag Queen, Hellion) converge behind the leader, creating traffic problems for the hold-up horses trying to get through.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pioneer Pete Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete maintains his kick when challenged 2f out
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner uses his tactical advantage and superior similar-going record to repel challengers. Hold-up horses struggle in the traffic behind the prominent pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Swamps Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners overwhelm Pioneer Pete from 2f out
scenarios.body: The weight of numbers tells as Hashtag Queen and Prince Of Clova use their class edge in the scrum. Pioneer Pete fades under pressure while hold-up horses remain trapped.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Threading Through
scenarios.trigger: If Our Guide or Finbarr find clear runs through the prominent traffic
scenarios.body: Our Guide's perfect similar-going record (2/2 with a win) proves decisive as he weaves through late. The prominent runners compromise each other's chances in their battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Millford Hill Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and stamina becomes the deciding factor
scenarios.body: Millford Hill's hold-up style works perfectly in a slowly-run race before his usual fade kicks in. The prominent pack goes too early and Pioneer Pete stops to nothing.

races.paceDynamic: Holeshot will likely lead from the start with Giovanni Change, Mixedwave, The Clonmel Kid and The Great Escape all positioned prominently behind him in the early stages. With five prominent runners but only one confirmed front-runner, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, setting up a tactical finish where the hold-up horses Cardamon Hill, Youdecide, Slaney Opera and Ithaka will need to time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Holeshot maintains a steady gallop without being seriously challenged for the lead
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will track comfortably but may lack the kick to get past a horse that's had an easy time in front. Holeshot's stamina and tactical advantage from leading unchallenged gives him the edge over the closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes modest and the race develops into a sprint finish from the last fence
scenarios.body: The closing quartet will have plenty left in the tank and can unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Cardamon Hill's class and Ithaka's high rating make them the most likely beneficiaries of a truly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Holeshot weakens turning for home and the prominent runners fail to capitalize immediately
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where horses coming from different positions all converge at once. Giovanni Change's recent win and Slaney Opera's strong staying form could see them emerge from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Breakdown
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Holeshot simultaneously from the home turn
scenarios.body: The pace quickens dramatically in the straight, causing several horses to empty out quickly. The patient hold-up horses who avoided the early battle will pick up the pieces late.

watchPoints.text: Holeshot's jumping under pressure - any mistake when challenged could end his chances quickly
How quickly the hold-up quartet of Cardamon Hill, Youdecide, Slaney Opera and Ithaka begin their moves
Whether Giovanni Change can repeat his front-running tactics from his recent win or settles differently
The jumping of Mixedwave and The Great Escape who need clean rounds to stay competitive
How much Ithaka's rating advantage tells if he gets the right setup from his hold-up position

races.paceDynamic: King Of The Road and Ionian will engage early as the confirmed front-runners, establishing a solid gallop through the extended trip. With multiple prominent racers like Freshers Week, Daylatedollarshort, and No Ordinary Joe positioned behind the leaders, the pace should be honest without being suicidal, setting up the race for the strong-staying types and hold-up horses to make their challenge from the back half of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favors Stayers
scenarios.trigger: If King Of The Road and Ionian maintain a searching gallop without one capitulating early
scenarios.body: The honest tempo stretches the field and finds out the non-stayers among the prominent racers. Hold-up horses like Miss Cynthia and Dunkerque get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Collapse Early
scenarios.trigger: If both King Of The Road and Ionian fade or fall before halfway, leaving a pace vacuum
scenarios.body: Prominent racers Freshers Week and Duel Au Soleil inherit the lead but face pressure from other forward types. The race becomes tactical with No Ordinary Joe's class telling late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Versatile
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses vying for position after the leaders falter
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo suits horses comfortable in any position, with Daylatedollarshort and Miss Cynthia able to adapt. Superior jumping becomes crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ionian Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Ionian gets an uncontested lead while King Of The Road struggles early
scenarios.body: The leader controls the tempo perfectly and uses superior fitness to dominate. Late challengers emerge but cannot bridge the gap to the long-time leader.

watchPoints.text: King Of The Road's recent form suggests he may not sustain his usual front-running role effectively.
No Ordinary Joe needs to bounce back from poor recent efforts to justify his highest rating.
Bras d'Or requires a strong early pace to be competitive from his hold-up position.
Ionian has been off the track and may need the run despite his pace advantages.
Speakasyoufind's finishing tendency makes him vulnerable in a competitive handicap finish.

races.paceDynamic: Parramount looks the most natural leader in this small field and should dictate terms from the front without serious pressure early. The three other prominent runners (Koapey, Gaelic Rambler, Zero Tolerance) are likely to track behind in a cluster, while Singapore Trip settles last as the only confirmed hold-up performer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Parramount Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Parramount jumps cleanly and maintains a steady gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner gets into an ideal rhythm and proves hard to peg back up the hill. Singapore Trip's late rally falls just short despite staying on strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Koapey and Gaelic Rambler both travel strongly and challenge Parramount turning for home
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners engage in a sustained battle from three out, setting up the race perfectly. Singapore Trip times his challenge to perfection as the pace collapses late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If multiple runners press Parramount early or dispute the lead through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and finds out stamina reserves over this trip. Gaelic Rambler's proven stamina at longer distances gives him the edge in a slog.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If the small field suffers fallers or significant jumping errors that disrupt the rhythm
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test with few left to fight out the finish. Zero Tolerance benefits from staying out of trouble despite limited recent winning form.

races.paceDynamic: Thank You Ma'am is the sole confirmed front-runner in this seven-runner field, meaning she can dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure. American Mike, Escapologist, and Jalisco Star will track prominently but are unlikely to challenge for the lead early, creating a tactical race where the hold-up horses Kent De Thaix, Jupiter Des Mottes, and Ballygeary must hope the pace becomes truly testing in the final mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am gets an easy lead and controls fractions through the first two miles
scenarios.body: She builds a decisive advantage over fences while the prominent horses mark each other and the hold-up brigade gets too far back. The pace becomes too slow for closers to make up ground despite her modest rating.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If American Mike or Escapologist press Thank You Ma'am early, creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop over three miles plays to the strengths of Kent De Thaix and Jupiter Des Mottes who can produce their best finishing kicks. Thank You Ma'am weakens in the final half-mile under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate and American Mike produces his best form off the higher rating
scenarios.body: He tracks Thank You Ma'am comfortably before asserting in the straight, with Jalisco Star and Escapologist fighting for minor honors. The hold-up horses struggle to make an impact from too far back in the small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady throughout and Ballygeary finds significant improvement from his lower rating
scenarios.body: His hold-up style proves perfectly suited to a slowly-run race where he can pick off tired leaders. The front-runners and prominent racers all stop quickly having gone too slow early.

watchPoints.text: Thank You Ma'am getting too easy a lead through the first two miles with no pressure from prominent runners

Kent De Thaix getting too far back in the small field where positions become crucial

races.paceDynamic: Jonquilla and Steady The Ship will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This honest pace will suit the large contingent of hold-up horses including Farmer Jimmy, Bodygroove, and the recent winner Yummy, setting up a cavalry charge finish over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla and Steady The Ship maintain a strong pace throughout without either fading dramatically
scenarios.body: The honest gallop stretches the field and creates perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to mount their challenges. Farmer Jimmy and Bodygroove benefit most from the strong pace, with their stamina telling late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners weaken significantly after the second-last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with prominent racers and those with tactical speed best placed. Jeteye and Rebel Intentions are ideally positioned to capitalize when the gallop dies.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla breaks clear turning for home and the pace hasn't been fast enough to stop her
scenarios.body: The highest-rated mare uses her class advantage and gets first run on her rivals. Steady The Ship also benefits from racing prominently but lacks Jonquilla's ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate with several horses tracking the leaders closely
scenarios.body: Multiple horses remain in contention turning for home, creating a messy finish where jumping becomes crucial. Recent winner Yummy and consistent Twoplacesatonetime thrive in tactical affairs.

races.paceDynamic: Middlecliffe shapes as the obvious pace-setter with several prominent runners (Cape Warrior, Noble Way, Cricket Hill Denis) likely to track close behind, creating a genuine pace through the early stages. Matador St Georges as the sole hold-up horse will need the pace to be strong enough to set up his late challenge, while the tactical battle between the prominent runners could create opportunities for both the leader and closer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners pressure Middlecliffe from halfway creating a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The pace becomes testing through the back straight, softening up the front runners for a late challenge. Matador St Georges gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Middlecliffe gets an easy lead with the prominent runners content to wait
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too steady for Matador St Georges while Middlecliffe conserves energy for a sustained finish. The leader kicks clear in the straight before the others can organize their challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Cape Warrior, Noble Way and Cricket Hill Denis engage in a tactical scrap behind Middlecliffe
scenarios.body: The front runners go too fast trying to outposition each other while Middlecliffe maintains rhythm. One of the prominent trackers times their move perfectly to strike between the tiring leader and late-closing Matador St Georges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners are too cautious early creating a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning and luck matter more than stamina or class. The race turns into a lottery where any horse finding daylight in the final 200 yards can prevail.

watchPoints.text: Middlecliffe getting too easy a lead early - needs pressure to prevent controlled finish
Matador St Georges getting boxed in or pace going too slow for his closing style to be effective
Cape Warrior's early positioning - his recent good form makes him key tactical player
Noble Way and Cricket Hill Denis fighting each other for same prominent pitch behind leader
A Sight To Sea's market moves given unknown quantity status in small competitive field
